2.1.4.7. om_integration.api.IntegrationConfig.use_alias_configuration¶

IntegrationConfig.use_alias_configuration(alias_cfg, unmatched_vars=None)¶

Setup integration rules by reusing alias configuration.

Parameters:

  • alias_cfg – AliasConfig instance from variable_alias.

  • unmatched_vars – In code import workflows, this parameter should be an Iterable of all the variables in the programs to integrate that could not be matched with the Prover iLock code model. Used to warn the user if an alias rule refers to a non-existing variable.
